why: One level, R 16, origin 0, voxel 0.25 m, valid range [0.375, 3.625] m on each axis (local [1.5, 14.5] voxels). Texels are filled analytically from the plane z 2.125 m: a = |z_centre - 2.125| metres, rgb 0. Texel centres sit at 0.25 k + 0.125 m, and k = 8 gives the centre 2.125 m exactly, so the plane lies on a layer of voxel centres. The texel values are a = 0.25 |k - 8|; a trilinear sample at z between two centres is the linear interpolation of those values, which on each side of the plane is exactly |z - 2.125| (h = |z - 2.125|, with no flat segment). So within the valid range the sample is h = |z - 2.125| at every point, and the nearest approach is h = 0 on the plane. Each ray is walked by the contract's rules: t from start, step clamp(h, 0.5 voxel, 4 voxel), hard hit only when h < 0.5 voxel (0.125 m) while approaching, otherwise res = min(res, d / (tan_half max(t - y, 1e-4))) with y = h^2 / (2 ph) when ph < 1e19 and h < 2 ph, d = sqrt(h^2 - y^2); a sample with h >= ph (plateau or receding) never darkens; the final value is smoothstep(clamp(res, 0, 1)). max_steps is 32 throughout.

cases.name: parallel to the plane
cases.why: Inputs unchanged; the plane moved from 2.0 to 2.125, so the derived h changes from 0.75 to 0.875. The ray stays at y 2.0 and z 1.25, inside the valid range, so level_at returns 0 for every sample, and h = |1.25 - 2.125| = 0.875 for every x. Sample 1 (t 0.25, x 1.25, ph 1e20): approaching; h < 0.125 is false; y = 0 because ph is not below 1e19; d = 0.875; res = min(1, 0.875 / (0.5 x 0.25)) = min(1, 7) = 1. Then ph = 0.875 and the step is clamp(0.875, 0.125, 1.0) = 0.875, so t = 1.125 (x 2.125, inside the range). Sample 2: h = 0.875 equals ph, so it is not approaching and never darkens. The step of 0.875 takes t to 2.0, beyond max_t 1.5, so the loop ends. res = 1, and smoothstep(1) = 1.

cases.name: toward the plane, blocked
cases.why: Hand walk along +z, z = 0.5 + t, x = 2.0 and y = 2.0 (local 8 voxels; every sample z lies in [0.75, 2.125], inside the range [0.375, 3.625], so level 0 holds throughout). Sample 1 (t 0.25, z 0.75): h = |0.75 - 2.125| = 1.375; ph is 1e20, so it is approaching, y = 0 and d = 1.375; res = min(1, 1.375 / (0.5 x 0.25)) = 1. Step clamp(1.375, 0.125, 1.0) = 1.0, so t = 1.25. Sample 2 (t 1.25, z 1.75): h = 0.375 < ph = 1.375, so approaching; h < 0.125 is false; y = 0.140625 / 2.75 = 0.051136; d = sqrt(0.140625 - 0.002615) = 0.371497; res = min(1, 0.371497 / (0.5 x 1.198864)) = 0.619749. Step clamp(0.375, 0.125, 1.0) = 0.375, so t = 1.625. Sample 3 (t 1.625, z 2.125): the texel centre on the plane gives h = 0 exactly (trilinear weight 0 on a = 0). h < 0.5 voxel = 0.125 and 0 < ph = 0.375, so the ray is approaching and the hard-hit branch returns 0 at once. Visibility 0.

cases.name: empty volume
cases.why: No level: level_at returns levels.len() = 0 at the first sample, the walk breaks before any sample, res stays 1 and smoothstep(1) = 1.
